/** * Reuse variable names if possible. * *

For example, from var x = 1; print(x); var y = 2; print(y); * to var x = 1; print(x); x = 2; print(x). The benefits are * slightly shorter code because of the removed var declaration, * less unique variables in hope for better renaming, and finally better gzip * compression. * *

The pass operates similar to a typical register allocator found in an * optimizing compiler by first computing live ranges with * {@link LiveVariablesAnalysis} and a variable interference graph. Then it uses * graph coloring in {@link GraphColoring} to determine which two variables can * be merge together safely. * * */
